Walsh inversion plus l1 saturation forces p_{a,b}=1/N exactly on correlated affine words, proving uniqueness. Exact integer verification exhausts input tables for m=2,4 and checks bent construction m=2,4,6,8. All m≥2 even are proved symbolically.

value.rationale: A complete sharp infinite family solves a natural fixed-codebook worst-coordinate randomized RAC optimization, identifies precisely the hard source tables, and certifies a unique optimal message distribution at those inputs. It yields a direct fast-Walsh sampler and a new operational interpretation of bent spectra. The fact is more structured than a routine small-table recomputation, although its underlying Fourier facts are classical.
